authorization: Active BAFU/Premise integration goal and standing auto-approval for analogous same-function, same-unit and declared-geography screening proxies with logged limitations.
scope: 24 electricity compatibility correspondences needed by the retained deep-geothermal heat workbook. This does not qualify the complete geothermal heat role.

source.name: market group for electricity, high voltage
market group for electricity, high voltage

limitations: Same declared region and voltage, positive delivered-kWh reference in the actual ecoinvent 3.6 cut-off source and both native UVEK releases. Use the complete native grid as a screening proxy; retain each signed caller kWh, formula, uncertainty and separately listed inventories. No voltage conversion, extra loss multiplier or new generation-share weighting is introduced.

Native generation/import mixes, grid losses, infrastructure, operating model, allocation and vintage replace the source market model. Legacy aggregate territory labels do not establish identical country boundaries. These composition, geographic and delivery-boundary differences have unquantified score effects; no LCIA equivalence is claimed.

Only the exact inspected ecoinvent 3.6 cut-off profile and the enumerated rules are reviewed. Other source versions, consequential conversions, different-voltage or different-geography fallbacks and non-electricity geothermal dependencies are outside this decision.

review.reason: Actual source and native provide positive one kWh high-voltage electricity at the grid/consumption boundary. Use the complete native RER high-voltage grid once, retaining its original signed generation/import exchanges, voltage-specific losses, network infrastructure and direct grid emissions. It replaces the source historical regional-country consumption mix with the native 2023 mix and boundary; country coverage, generation/import technology, allocation, geography and vintage differences remain explicit. Do not substitute a production busbar or lower voltage, add a second loss factor, clip negative native coefficients or introduce a new IAM/grid algorithm. Existing shared Premise electricity updates continue to act on native suppliers.

reference_flow_sign_review.reason: Only exact independently inspected cut-off profiles authorize this target/reference basis.
